title: Metagenome from PHA-accumulating mixed microbial cultures
description: 16S amplicon results from mixed microbial consortia enriched for selective conversion of volatile fatty acids into polyhydroxyalkanoates while leaving 1,3-propanediol in culture broth
samples: Mixed culture from activated and anaerobic sludge. Enrichment in PHA producers from fermented crude glycerol and volatile fatty acids.
Denmark: Site A (Dakavej 10,8723 Losning) and Site B (Hjortekaerbakken 12, 2800 Kongens Lyngby)
environmental sample; urban association not established
